title: Variable count of the validity formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers such that $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$. The configuration-validity CNF formula has at most $C(s+n+1)$ variables.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5
